Reflected/stored XSS sink: ticket replies — which are free-text authored by any user including customer_user accounts (AddReplyDto, up to 10000 chars) — are rendered via [innerHTML]="reply.content | nl2br". The Nl2brPipe (nl2br.pipe.ts:7) converts untrusted text into an HTML string (`value.replace(/\n/g, '

Reply content should be rendered as text with CSS white-space, not HTML.
